referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset represents the activity of waste disposal of waste paint in a construction waste landfill. Recommended use of this dataset: For minor amounts going to construction waste landfill as part of a building product (eg. paint on concrete). Large amounts of separated paint cannot go into this type of landfill.Inventoried waste consists of fraction: 100% paint (remains); . technology.text: This is an inventory for a construction waste landfill (mostly mineral C&D waste, VVEA type B). Ultimate average landfill height is 11 meters. Operation phase duration is 15 years.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Landfill model based on average mineral building waste composition and observed average leachate concentrations from various literature sources. Extrapolated to 60'000 years heeding chemical characteristics and hydrology. Based on waste composition and climate data the end of carbonate phase of this landfill is estimated to be reached beyond 60'000 years.
representativeness.uncertaintyAdjustments: uncertainty of waste input composition data derived from generic formula GSD(c) = N*ln(c)+1. *Mean* long-term emissions are the emissions until 60'000 years after waste placement. *Maximal* (upper bound) long-term emissions are the complete emissions of all landfilled material, depicting possible mechanical landfill failures and/or natural erosion not heeded in the mean value. Minimal long-term emissions are derived implicitly from the mean and maximal values assuming a lognormal distribution.
